reference_repeatability.required: bitwise equality for every captured array in the locked CPU toolchain

precision_rationale.largest_reduction: decoder convolution: 1090 input channels times a 3-tap kernel
precision_rationale.explanation: The largest configured dot-product reduction is the decoder convolution with 1090 input channels and a 3-tap kernel. Its standard float32 accumulation bound gamma_n = n*u/(1-n*u) is about 1.949452e-4. The 1e-3 stage relative bound is about 5.13 such bounds; the 1e-5 absolute floor covers values near zero. Waveform normalized RMSE uses the same 1e-3 floor (about 60 dB signal-to-error ratio), with a 2e-3 peak cap. Comparisons are made at each module boundary so these limits do not compound silently across the full graph. These budgets are fixed from repeated-reference behavior and float32 arithmetic before native C output exists.
